access.notes: Standard thermochemical reference; publicly available from NIST or computational thermochemistry databases. Contains enthalpy, entropy, heat capacity for Ar, H2, H, N2, N, NH3, NH4Cl, HCl, Cl2, SiCl4, SiCl2, SiCl, Si(g), Si(l), Si3N4(s).
Any library capable of Gibbs free energy minimization or equilibrium constant solution with JANAF data can be used; Cantera is recommended as a widely-available option.
